# design-skill

> One agent skill for designing any user-facing surface with taste
> built in: sense the brief, derive grounded directions and let dice
> assign one (challengers dealt from a deck of born-designed graphic
> systems), write the chosen world into the artifact as a five-block
> promise, build with full commitment against a token contract, and
> review the render against the promise in a fresh context. Seven
> material languages sharing one token schema; a worlds deck with a
> CJK half; a craft layer loaded by need; surface recipes; runnable
> bans. MIT.

One repo, one skill. The installed unit is `skills/design-skill/`;
everything above it is packaging. Install with `npx skills@latest add
lroolle/design-skill`, or as a Claude Code plugin (`/plugin
marketplace add lroolle/design-skill`), or by copying
`skills/design-skill/` into any agent's skill root. No build step;
`bans.sh` and `validate.sh` are bash + grep, `roll.mjs` is node with
no dependencies.

## Entry

- [skills/design-skill/SKILL.md](skills/design-skill/SKILL.md): the
  protocol -- gate, laws, six phases (sense, direct, contract, build,
  review, deliver), the modes, the first-sense table by territory, the
  check, the skill map

## Decks and dice

- [worlds/README.md](skills/design-skill/worlds/README.md): what a world is, tiers, ratings, the deal; one card per `worlds/<id>.md`
- [stagings/README.md](skills/design-skill/stagings/README.md): compositions for surface-scope rolls; `stagings/<id>.md`
- [scripts/roll.mjs](skills/design-skill/scripts/roll.mjs): `node scripts/roll.mjs --scope direction|surface --mode <mode> [--grain] [--key] [--reroll n] [--json]`

## Design systems (material contracts; same token names, swap the css file)

- [design-systems/README.md](skills/design-skill/design-systems/README.md): the table, the
  12-section contract schema, the token contract and its invariants
- [default](skills/design-skill/design-systems/default.md) · [modernist](skills/design-skill/design-systems/modernist.md) ·
  [classical](skills/design-skill/design-systems/classical.md) · [industry](skills/design-skill/design-systems/industry.md) ·
  [organic](skills/design-skill/design-systems/organic.md) · [nocturnes](skills/design-skill/design-systems/nocturnes.md) ·
  [broadsheets](skills/design-skill/design-systems/broadsheets.md) · [_template](skills/design-skill/design-systems/_template.md)
- tokens: `skills/design-skill/assets/tokens/<system>.css` (light + dark, OKLCH);
  [assets/specimen.html](skills/design-skill/assets/specimen.html) renders any of them

## Templates (surface recipes)

- [templates/README.md](skills/design-skill/templates/README.md): landing, dashboard, docs,
  editorial, portfolio, app-shell, forms, deck, _template

## The skill used on itself

- [site/README.md](site/README.md): the page at lroolle.com/design-skill -- static, no build step, base-path agnostic; how to run, prove and graft it
- [site/DESIGN.md](site/DESIGN.md): the material contract written at finish -- the roll and its verdicts, the world as built, what was deferred with reasons, the evidence, and the defects this build found in the skill
- [site/index.html](site/index.html): the promise is the first comment in the body
